definitions.explanation: The legal right to participate in elections by casting a vote.

examples.japanese: {選挙権|せんきょけん}を{得|え}る。
examples.english: To obtain the right to vote.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}では{十八歳|じゅうはっさい}から{選挙権|せんきょけん}がある。
examples.english: In Japan, you have the right to vote from age eighteen.

examples.japanese: {成年|せいねん}に{達|たっ}すると{選挙権|せんきょけん}が{得|え}られる。
examples.english: Upon reaching adulthood, one can obtain the right to vote.

notes:
{選挙権|せんきょけん} is composed of {選挙|せんきょ} (election) + {権|けん} (right).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {選挙権|せんきょけん}を{持|も}つ: to have the right to vote
- {選挙権|せんきょけん}を{得|え}る: to gain the right to vote
- {選挙権|せんきょけん}を{行使|こうし}する: to exercise one's right to vote

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, the voting age was lowered from 20 to 18 in 2016.
